prompts.name: clearsighted
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Redesign attached clearsighted tabletop status icon while preserving its recognizable BLUE OPEN EYE with gold upper eyelid. Second attached flame is graphic style reference ONLY: strong thick dark outlines, saturated colors, drawn dimensional shading and broad crisp highlights. One large bright cyan-blue eye, round deep blue iris and large dark navy pupil, clear focused gaze, sculpted golden upper eyelid and rich blue lower eyelid. Remove ALL surrounding glitter stars, sparkles, floating dots, hazy cyan aura, rays and external decorative strokes. The eye itself should have character: a few controlled broad iris segments, two deliberate reflections and dimensional gold shading, without tiny striations or overly simple flat fill. Clear-sighted, alert and focused expression, not angry. Strong continuous dark navy contour, matching bold cartoon fantasy game icon style. Moderate illustrative detail and volume, no brushwork, mottling, painted texture or photorealism, no flat emoji look. Keep open eye centered on square canvas with comfortable margins, actual transparent background. No text, badge or extra objects.

prompts.name: confused
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. First attached confused.webp is the edit target, second flame is only a graphic style reference for thick dark outlines and rich dimensional drawn shading. Refine the original confusion icon of THREE golden five-point stars orbiting in a dizzy circle. Preserve its charming expressive golden stars, brown contours, rich yellow-orange shading, curved golden motion trails and recognizable concept. Crucial correction: overall orbit should be CIRCULAR face-on, equal height and width, not a tilted ellipse or elongated spiral. Three stars spaced evenly around an imaginary true circle, each slightly rotated to give movement. Connect them with three separate broad tapered swooshes following the circle, visibly interrupted behind stars; do NOT draw a rigid solid hoop or wreath. Preserve good moderate illustrative detail in the stars with sculpted light and shadow, layered golden ribbon highlights, more personality than flat pictograms. Remove secondary tiny four-point glitter stars and dots only. Bold continuous brown outer contours, clean saturated illustrated shading, no brush texture or photorealism. Clear circular balanced composition readable at 48–64px, comfortable margins, square actual transparent background. No text, badge, face or extra symbols.

prompts.name: phased
prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. First attached phased.webp is the edit target; second flame is graphic style reference ONLY: bold thick dark contours, saturated clean shapes, dimensional drawn shadow and crisp highlights, no painted texture. Rework the PHASED status concept into a clearly readable BLUE SPECTRAL HUMANOID PASSING THROUGH A SOLID WALL. Compact three-quarter side composition: a short vertical violet-gray wall section on the right, showing only a few large stone blocks with a visible side edge for thickness. On the left, the cyan-blue ghost's head, shoulder, upper torso and one reaching hand have already emerged through the intact wall. Its rear torso visibly intersects and disappears INSIDE the wall halfway through: the wall is NOT broken, no hole or doorway. Head is a simple smooth spectral human-like profile with one pale eye, not a horned monster, superhero mask or detailed realistic person. One open reaching hand with a few clearly drawn fingers; avoid a second floating/disconnected arm. Draw dark outlines of all major contours including the intersection with the wall; use layered blue shadow and cyan highlights for convincing volume and ethereal character without relying on haze. Preserve original blue/violet palette and phase-through-wall idea, remove sparkles, speed lines, disconnected wisps and tiny masonry texture. Moderate illustrative detail; not flat minimalist pictogram, not painted rendering or photorealism. Clear silhouette readable at 48–64px. Full composition within square canvas with comfortable margins, genuine transparent background, no text, badge or glow cloud.
